title: Design-Engineer
description: Job Title: Electronic System Design Engineer Job Summary: As an Electronics Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for the system-level design, development and validation of defence equipment. You will define system architectures, allocate requirements to subsystems, perform system engineering analyses, and ensure that the overall system meets operational, performance, reliability, safety, and environmental requirements. Key Responsibilities: 1. System Architecture and Design Develop and maintain system-level architectures for defence electronic systems. Translate customer and operational requirements into system requirements and technical specifications. Define functional, physical, and interface architectures of complex defence systems. Allocate system requirements to electrical, electronic, mechanical, software, hydraulic, and communication subsystems. Conduct trade-off studies and system analyses to optimize performance, reliability, maintainability, and cost. 2. Requirements Engineering Capture, analyse, document, and manage system requirements. Ensure traceability from customer requirements to subsystem and verification requirements. Manage requirement changes and assess their impact on overall system performance. 3. System Integration Define interfaces between electrical, electronic, software, communication, and mechanical subsystems. Support subsystem integration activities and resolve interface-related issues. Coordinate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure seamless system integration. Participate in integration troubleshooting activities. 4. Verification and Validation Develop system verification and validation strategies and plans. Define test requirements, acceptance criteria, and qualification procedures. Support laboratory, field, environmental, and platform-level testing activities. Verify system performance against customer specifications requirements. Participate in system qualification, acceptance, and certification activities. 5. Defence Standards and Compliance Ensure compliance with applicable defence and military standards. Verify adherence to standards related to environmental, EMC/EMI, reliability, maintainability, safety, and human factors. Support design reviews and compliance assessments throughout the development. 6. Technical Reviews and Risk Management Conduct System Requirements Reviews, Preliminary Design Reviews (PDR), and Critical Design Reviews (CDR). Identify technical risks and develop mitigation strategies. Evaluate design changes and their impact on overall system performance and compliance. Support configuration management and change control processes. 7. Documentation and Reporting Prepare and maintain system engineering documentation. Maintain complete traceability of requirements, design decisions, and verification evidence. 8. Continuous Improvement Stay updated with emerging defence technologies, systems engineering methodologies, and military standards. Recommend improvements to system engineering processes, tools, and practices. Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field. Experience: 06-12 years of experience in systems engineering, system integration, or development of complex systems. Skills: Strong knowledge of Systems Engineering principles and lifecycle processes. Experience in system architecture development and requirements management. Familiarity with defence industry standards and regulatory requirements (e.g., MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461). Proficiency in using simulation and analysis tools for system scheme. Familiarity with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) concepts is desirable. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Working Conditions: Office environment with possible occasional visits to manufacturing facilities. Full-time position with standard working hours; some flexibility may be required based on project needs.

Undertake frequent site visits to Habshan to coordinate with construction personnel, inspect field conditions, review construction progress, identify engineering constraints and facilitate timely resolution of technical issues affecting site execution. Act as a key liaison between site-based construction teams and office-based engineering disciplines, ensuring that field observations, technical queries, design discrepancies and construction feedback are communicated clearly and addressed within agreed timelines. Coordinate and expedite the resolution of requests for information, technical queries, field change requests, design clarifications, technical deviations and engineering-related non-conformance reports in accordance with established project procedures. Ensure that engineering deliverables are developed and issued in accordance with approved project specifications, applicable international codes and standards, ADNOC requirements, quality procedures and document control protocols. Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering interfaces across process, mechanical, piping, civil, structural, electrical, instrumentation, control systems, telecom, fire and gas, HVAC and other applicable disciplines. Assist in the management of engineering changes by coordinating technical assessments, obtaining discipline inputs, documenting the rationale for proposed changes and evaluating potential impacts on scope, cost, schedule, quality, procurement and construction. Support the maintenance of project risk registers and interface registers by identifying technical risks, recording constraints, tracking mitigation measures and escalating issues requiring management intervention. Coordinate brownfield engineering activities, where applicable, including existing facility surveys, site verification, tie-in interfaces, design modifications and technical coordination with operations and construction teams. Support engineering coordination for construction activities within or adjacent to operating gas processing facilities, ensuring that technical solutions account for operational constraints, safety requirements and applicable permit-to-work and SIMOPS arrangements. Work closely with HSE and process safety teams to ensure that engineering activities address identified hazards, design risks, safety study recommendations and relevant operational integrity requirements. Ensure engineering-related quality issues are documented, communicated and resolved through the approved quality management system, including appropriate closure of technical comments, non-conformances and corrective actions. Coordinate the preparation and closure of engineering actions arising from project meetings, technical reviews, site inspections, design reviews, client comments and construction coordination sessions. Prepare engineering status reports, technical summaries, action trackers, deliverables forecasts and other project documentation required by the Lead Project Engineer, Engineering Manager and Project Manager. Support the implementation of project document control requirements, ensuring that drawings, specifications, technical correspondence and engineering deliverables are appropriately reviewed, approved, distributed and maintained at the correct revision. Coordinate with commissioning and system completion teams to ensure that engineering documentation, technical clarifications, system information and outstanding design actions are addressed in support of pre-commissioning, commissioning and start-up. Support the preparation and completion of as-built documentation, engineering handover records, technical dossiers, vendor documentation and other required deliverables for final project handover to ADNOC Gas. Promote effective communication, teamwork and accountability among engineering disciplines and project stakeholders, ensuring that technical issues are addressed proactively and that commitments are followed through to completion. Identify opportunities for design optimization, value engineering, standardization and improved engineering coordination while maintaining compliance with approved technical requirements and safety standards. Ensure that lessons learned, recurring technical issues and site feedback are captured and communicated to the relevant engineering teams to prevent rework and improve project performance. Perform other duties within the scope of the position as required to support the safe, timely and successful delivery of the project. Minimum 12 to 15 years of experience in the Oil & Gas industry. Proven experience in ADNOC Gas projects. Thorough knowledge and practical application of DGS, AGES, and AGPS standards. Strong background in Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) projects. Extensive site construction experience in operating Oil & Gas facilities. Experience in Gas Processing Plants and shutdown/turnaround execution. Hands-on experience in brownfield modification projects, including work within live operating facilities. Proven experience in planning and execution of large-diameter piping tie-ins. Experience in heavy lifting and installation of large vessels and static equipment. Ability to coordinate multidiscipline activities involving engineering, construction, commissioning, and operations teams. Strong legal drafting and documentation skills. Good analytical and document-review skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to identify documentation discrepancies.
